name: Claude Bryan
source:
The Principal of St. Elmo's and the youngest principal in history. One of the three Lords of Volcano Kingdom, but has personally expressed greater interest in research.

He wasn't the brightest as a child but demonstrated amazing ability when he entered the research institute and published many vital papers on magical creatures with his team.

He is always kind to his students and no one has ever seen him angry.

[Edited from in-game bio]
